sources.text: The warranty expires in 2025. Coverage does not extend to consequential loss.

cases.rationale: Both statements fix a single year and the years differ, so the source is incompatible with the claim.

input.answer: The refund request must be made before 2024.

sources.text: The refund request must be made before 2026.

cases.rationale: A 2026 deadline is compatible with a stricter 2024 deadline, so the source does not contradict the claim. This is the same logical trap as the revised development case, in new clothing.

input.answer: Initech signed the agreement on 3 March 2024.

sources.text: Globex signed the agreement on 3 March 2024. Umbrella signed the agreement on 11 June 2024.

cases.rationale: The date matches exactly but the entity does not. A number-and-keyword matcher would call this supported.

input.answer: The number of active users in 2024 was 12,000.

sources.text: The number of paying customers in 2024 was 12,000. The number of active users in 2024 was 48,000.

cases.rationale: The passage states the number of active users in 2024 was 48,000, which is incompatible with the claim of 12,000. The first label for this case was insufficient_evidence, written on the assumption that the number 12,000 belonging to a different metric made the claim unsupported rather than refuted. The passage states the claimed metric directly and states a different value, so the label was wrong and the model was right.
cases.notes: Label corrected after the first observed model run.

input.answer: The office is located in Dublin.

sources.text: The monthly service fee is 2,400 EUR per calendar month.
The registered office is located at 12 Bridge Street, Dublin.

cases.rationale: One of two sources answers the claim. Retrieval has to find the right one among distractors.

input.answer: If the customer cancels early, the deposit is forfeited.

sources.text: If the customer cancels early, the deposit is forfeited. If the customer completes the full term, the deposit is returned.

cases.rationale: The condition and its consequence are both stated, so the conditional claim is supported.

input.answer: Support is available in English and Irish.

sources.text: Support is available in English, Irish, and French.

cases.rationale: The source covers a superset of the claim. That is compatible with it, but a partial-support reading of a list claim is exactly the trap the citation project exists to catch, so the safe answer is to abstain rather than assert.
